sections.changelog:
Changed

  • `mvweb_bc_format_number()` now treats the decimals argument as a maximum and strips trailing zeros (and a dangling separator). Whole and short results render cleanly across all calculators and converters (e.g. `1 m` instead of `1.0000 m`, `1 000 mm` instead of `1 000.0000 mm`) while small values keep the precision they need (`0.00001 bar` is preserved).
